questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6993359d5a67ae4933bc75c5108712001a099e29d654627cae1a60cd60242cd2.png] 

How many morning walkers are music-lovers but are NOT engineers?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b8ea9158026a7f023880873ecf660edac27c0a9e3fa84f330582febbaa61d82.png]

questions.question:

How many dancers are either gymnasts or singers but NOT both?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72182520896e7e7296a88ce10339c425d2a1c045bdb42b22068e878c451fb66.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3d250916baf4fa2499627e5258ca30584922e129a9fbbb1e4afdf26d72f7957.png] 

There are 3 + 7 = 10 dancers are gymnasts but not dancers and gymnasts and singers and there are 9 dancers and singers but not dancers and gymnasts and singers.

questions.question:
In the given Venn diagram, the 'Triangle' represents 'females', 'Circle' represents 'graduates'; the 'Rectangle' represents 'Employed' and the 'Square' represents 'Youth(under 30 years)'. The numbers given in the diagram represents number of persons of that particular category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65d963aa7940e15aed45032ca6d56e710d4d288f879e79e5c748abb0c136d809.png] 

How many female graduates who are under 30 years are employed?
questions.solution:
The given Venn Diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65d963aa7940e15aed45032ca6d56e710d4d288f879e79e5c748abb0c136d809.png] 

Triangle → Female

Circle → Graduates

Rectangle → Employed

Square → Youth under 30

The number that is common in the circle, square, rectangle, and triangle represents the female graduates who are under 30 years and are employed.

Clearly, '5' lies in the circle, triangle, rectangle, and square.

Hence, there are **5 female graduates under 30 who are employed**.

questions.question: In a class of 75 students, 40 students participate in Cricket, 28 students participate in Hockey, and 12 students participate in both Cricket and Hockey, whereas 19 students do not participate in any of the two sports. How many students participate only in Hockey?
questions.solution:
In a class of 75 students.

19 students do not participate in any of the two sports. 

 
• Students who participate in any of the two sports or both the sports = 75 - 19 = 56

12 students participate in both Cricket and Hockey.

40 students participate in Cricket.</

questions.question: In a class of 45 students, all students participate in one or both of the two games, i.e. Chess and Badminton on. 11 students participate in both the games, whereas 17 students participate only in Chess. How many total students participate in Badminton?
questions.solution:
According to the given information the Venn diagram will be,

Let, Chess (C), Badminton (B) and n = total number of students in all

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f167b7a64144f855a89d302be3cb8f074d7be4c0002d6a094dfe690aa16def0.png] 

Thus, the total students participate in badminton = 45 - 17 = 28

Hence, the correct answer is '__**28**__'.

questions.question:

options.text: Coffee-lovers who are either car-owners or social workers
Coffee-lovers who are car-owners and social workers also
Car-owners who are coffee-lovers but not social workers
Coffee-lovers who are car-owners, social workers and clerks also

questions.solution:
Refer to the diagram as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8afca12e08ba2557d096baa76a925b9375720bdda198bdd1fcbea58aafda71.png]
